{{Quote|I didn't know she could ballroom dance. Odd for a Wookiee.|Garik Loran about Huhunna|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
The '''Ballroom dance''' was a type of formal dance between two partners. One hand would be placed on their partner's hip and the other would hold their partner's corresponding hand up and elevated.

In [[44 ABY]], [[Wraith Squadron]] members [[Voort saBinring]] and [[Huhunna]] ballroom danced near the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after the squadron's successful [[Mission to Kuratooine|mission]] on [[Kuratooine]].<ref name="MK" />
